body.purpose: Caption text, sequence identity and workspace tabs; semibold where the component requires it.

label.purpose: Compact field labels, controls and disclosure headings.

components.name: Neutral Button
components.description: Compact secondary action with immediate hover, press and keyboard feedback.
components.css: .ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:var(--caption-space-s, .5rem);min-block-size:2.25rem;border:1px solid var(--color-panel-border, #414141);border-radius:var(--caption-radius, .25rem);padding:.4rem .75rem;background:var(--color-surface-raised, #363636);color:var(--color-panel-text, #ededed);font-family:"Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;font-size:var(--caption-type-s,.923rem);font-weight:400;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;}.ds-button:active:enabled{background:var(--color-input, oklch(23% .002 260));}.ds-button:hover:enabled{background:var(--color-surface-overlay, #454545);border-color:var(--color-panel-secondary, #b0b0b0);}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(80% .105 258));outline-offset:2px;}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default;}

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main apply action; the installed output area raises its minimum height to 2.5rem.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:var(--caption-space-s, .5rem);min-block-size:2.25rem;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--caption-radius, .25rem);padding:.4rem .75rem;background:var(--color-primary, oklch(49% .15 258));color:#fff;font-family:"Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;font-size:var(--caption-type-s,.923rem);font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;}.ds-primary:active:enabled{background:var(--color-input, oklch(23% .002 260));}.ds-primary:hover:enabled{background:var(--color-primary-hover, oklch(55% .15 258));border-color:transparent;}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(80% .105 258));outline-offset:2px;}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default;}

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Transparent square action for refresh or dismiss controls.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon" aria-label="Refresh sequence"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M16 7a6.5 6.5 0 1 0 .3 5M16 3v4h-4"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:var(--caption-space-s, .5rem);min-block-size:2.25rem;inline-size:2.25rem;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--caption-radius, .25rem);padding:.4rem;background:transparent;color:var(--color-panel-text, #ededed);font-family:"Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;font-size:var(--caption-type-s,.923rem);font-weight:400;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;}.ds-icon:active:enabled{background:var(--color-input, oklch(23% .002 260));}.ds-icon:hover:enabled{background:var(--color-surface-overlay, #454545);border-color:var(--color-panel-secondary, #b0b0b0);}.ds-icon:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(80% .105 258));outline-offset:2px;}.ds-icon:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default;}.ds-icon svg{inline-size:1.25rem;block-size:1.25rem;}

components.name: Labeled Field
components.description: Explicit label, recessed field and shared focus outline.
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.375rem;min-inline-size:0;color:var(--color-panel-secondary, #b0b0b0);font-family:"Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;font-size:var(--caption-type-s,.923rem);line-height:1.45;}.ds-field input{inline-size:100%;min-inline-size:0;min-block-size:2.25rem;border:1px solid var(--color-panel-border, #414141);border-radius:var(--caption-radius, .25rem);color:var(--color-panel-text, #ededed);background:var(--color-input, oklch(23% .002 260));padding:.4rem .55rem;font:inherit;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;caret-color:var(--color-accent, oklch(80% .105 258));}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:var(--color-panel-secondary, #b0b0b0);}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(80% .105 258));outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: Flat workspace tabs with a restrained blue active underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:var(--caption-space-l, 1.125rem);padding-inline:var(--caption-space-l, 1.125rem);border-block-end:1px solid var(--color-panel-border, #414141);background:var(--color-surface, #292929);font-family:"Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.45;}.ds-tab{padding:.8rem .15rem;border:0;border-block-end:2px solid transparent;background:transparent;color:var(--color-panel-secondary, #b0b0b0);font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;}.ds-tab:hover{color:var(--color-panel-text, #ededed);}.ds-tab[aria-selected="true"]{color:var(--color-accent, oklch(80% .105 258));border-block-end-color:var(--color-accent, oklch(80% .105 258));}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(80% .105 258));outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Word State Navigation
components.description: Compact filled tabs distinguish upcoming, current and spoken word styling.
components.css: .ds-states{display:flex;gap:.25rem;padding:.25rem;border:1px solid var(--color-panel-border, #414141);border-radius:var(--caption-radius, .25rem);background:var(--color-input, oklch(23% .002 260));font-family:"Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;font-size:var(--caption-type-s,.923rem);line-height:1.45;}.ds-state{flex:1;padding:.45rem .2rem;border:0;border-radius:var(--caption-radius, .25rem);background:transparent;color:var(--color-panel-secondary, #b0b0b0);font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;}.ds-state:hover{color:var(--color-panel-text, #ededed);}.ds-state[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--color-selection, oklch(38% .043 258));color:var(--color-panel-text, #ededed);}.ds-state:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(80% .105 258));outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Fixture Status Tag
components.description: Noninteractive outlined tag used only for the browser demo state.

components.name: Selected Caption Cue
components.description: Selectable transcript row with ordinal, tabular timing and wrapping text.
components.css: .ds-cue{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;inline-size:100%;gap:var(--caption-space-m, .875rem);text-align:start;background:var(--color-selection, oklch(38% .043 258));color:var(--color-panel-text, #ededed);padding:var(--caption-space-m, .875rem) var(--caption-space-l, 1.125rem);border:0;border-block-end:1px solid var(--color-panel-border, #414141);font-family:"Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;}.ds-cue:hover{background:var(--color-surface-raised, #363636);}.ds-cue:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(80% .105 258));outline-offset:-2px;}.ds-cue-number{color:var(--color-panel-secondary, #b0b0b0);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:var(--caption-type-xs,.846rem);line-height:1.45;padding-block-start:.1rem;}.ds-cue-body{flex:1;min-inline-size:0;}.ds-cue-time{display:block;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--color-panel-secondary, #b0b0b0);font-size:var(--caption-type-xs,.846rem);line-height:1.45;margin-block-end:.3rem;}.ds-cue-text{display:block;font-size:var(--caption-type-m,1rem);line-height:1.5;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}

components.name: Settings Section
components.description: Flat disclosure container used instead of floating cards.
components.html:
Animation & fades

Show the whole caption and follow the spoken word.
components.css: .ds-section{border-block-end:1px solid var(--color-panel-border, #414141);color:var(--color-panel-text, #ededed);background:transparent;font-family:"Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;line-height:1.45;}.ds-section-heading{cursor:pointer;padding:var(--caption-space-m, .875rem) var(--caption-space-l, 1.125rem);font-size:var(--caption-type-s,.923rem);font-weight:600;}.ds-section-heading::marker{color:var(--color-panel-secondary, #b0b0b0);font-size:.8em;}.ds-section-heading:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(80% .105 258));outline-offset:2px;}.ds-section-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:var(--caption-space-m, .875rem);padding:var(--caption-space-s, .5rem) var(--caption-space-l, 1.125rem) var(--caption-space-l, 1.125rem);}.ds-help{margin:0;font-size:var(--caption-type-xs,.846rem);line-height:1.5;color:var(--color-panel-secondary, #b0b0b0);}

narrative.overview:
Better Captions belongs beside footage in Premiere: calm charcoal surfaces, compact system typography and familiar rectangular controls. Blue identifies selection, focus and the main action; neutral hierarchy keeps the transcript readable under controlled ambient light.

The interface is dense without hiding state. Labels stay explicit, timing uses tabular figures, and supporting detail opens through native disclosures. The browser review shell is a fixture, not part of the installed panel’s visual system.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces with visible keyboard states.

rules.name: The Host Palette Rule
rules.body: Honor the host’s background, text, border and secondary-text overrides. The documented fallbacks describe the browser fixture; they must not replace host theme values.

rules.name: The Steady Type Rule
rules.body: Keep interface text on the system stack. Fonts selected for rendered captions are content settings, not UI typography.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tonal changes and thin separators for hierarchy. The panel has no box-shadow vocabulary; the focus outline communicates interaction, not elevation.

dos: Do honor host background, text, border and secondary-text overrides.
Do use the shared spacing, corner and type scales for new controls.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, explicit field labels and tabular timing.
Do use muted semantic status colors with actionable text.
Do keep details in named disclosures when they would crowd a narrow panel.
donts: Don't replace system UI typography with decorative display lettering.
Don't add ornamental shadows or motion to the flat host controls.
Don't use selection blue as a general container background.
Don't confuse user-configurable caption output styling with panel UI tokens.
Don't carry the browser review toolbar or synthetic fixture labels into native chrome.
